submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 with a 36 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 93.495% among all three candidate algorithms across the allowed threshold range. A comprehensive scan was performed: initial coarse scan at 20, 40, and 60 GeV identified Algorithm-L2 as the most promising (91.897% at 40 GeV), followed by refined scanning in the 25-55 GeV range which revealed the optimal performance at 36 GeV. This represents a significant improvement over the reference efficiency of 92% for Algorithm-L2 at 35 GeV, and substantially outperforms Algorithm-L1 (max 74.134% at 40 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (max 84.079% at 40 GeV). The algorithm meets all hardware deployability requirements and operates within the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz.
